sign_off.notes:
I found no defects in the media tab, album browsing or favorites, so I filed no reports. Here is what I checked.
- Media tab chips: Media, Photos and Videos each showed the right counts and content. The empty state for Videos was correct.
- Album browsing: IrisSeed showed 2 items in the albums list. The grid showed both photos and kept them after rotating to landscape and back.
- Photo details: huge.jpg showed 2.5 MB and big.jpg showed 1.5 MB, matching the preconditions.
- Favorites: after favoriting big.jpg, it appeared in Favorites and showed a heart in the album grid. After unfavoriting it, the Favorites empty state appeared. Favorites also stayed correct while the Media chip was set to Videos.
- Not verified: I couldn't see an item count in the album grid header, so I couldn't check the changed header count directly. The albums list did show "2 items".
- Not tested: restarting the app to see whether the chip choice persists, and any sort or search options.
- One thing I left unreported: the bottom-nav label for the Media tab changes to match the chosen chip (Photos or Videos). I assumed that is intended.
